# Superpowers source notice

The pre-adaptation Skill body matches Jesse Vincent's Superpowers commit ebdd4ec61f2f560bada4f6ded7b0806e62bf33f7 after removal of YAML frontmatter and surrounding whitespace only. Firefly subsequently adapted the distributed body for its registered IDs, tool contracts and authorization boundaries; the current body is not byte-identical to that upstream version.
Source: https://github.com/obra/superpowers/tree/ebdd4ec61f2f560bada4f6ded7b0806e62bf33f7

The inherited Firefly archive uses sp- IDs and Code mode frontmatter. This notice adds upstream MIT permission without renaming IDs or enabling additional capabilities. It does not declare this archive an official Superpowers release. User settings, permissions and existing runtime remain authoritative.

For using-superpowers's supplementary references, codex-tools.md, gemini-tools.md and pi-tools.md match that commit as full bytes. antigravity-tools.md matches public commits a868631a8a4a942656b7837b60f24c393f86547a and 55d28ddf1066736bc10483c3c29f8770d911f7a9 instead. It is an inherited supplementary source, not a Firefly tool contract or evidence that all archive files share one upstream version.

Full MIT text is in LICENSE. Other inherited Skill families have separate origins and are not licensed by this notice.
